pages.text: Elephants, whales, the Laviathan and a few other giants are far too heavy to carry. Their carcass falls where they die. Bleed it with a cleaver right there, 2000 mB of blood, then cut it up in place.
pages.title: Where It Falls

pages.text: A blood grate under the carcass still catches the blood; without one it pools on the ground. The Void Worm needs Butchery's boss tool, the netherite cleaver, for the killing blow before it leaves a carcass at all.
